title: Knowledge3D: a GPU-native reference implementation for W3C PM-KR
description: Web knowledge is fragmented: duplicated across fonts, embeddings, metadata and renderings. Humans see pixels, AI sees tokens, and neither shares the source. Knowledge3D is a sovereign, GPU-native reference implementation for the W3C PM-KR Community Group, where humans and AI consume the same procedural knowledge from one source.
